python3 - <<'PY'
# Treasury silver holdings (dependent) vs gold holdings (independent)
# FY 1953 to FY 1962, nominal level values, dollar amounts in millions
# Source: Table 2 "Monetary Stocks of Gold and Silver"

gold   = [22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9,
          21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2]
silver = [3814.3,  3863.1,  3922.4,  3994.5,  4116.6,
          4306.0,  4414.1,  4394.5,  4346.5,  4317.4]

years = list(range(1953, 1963))
print("FY    Gold      Silver")
for y, g, s in zip(years, gold, silver):
    print(f"{y}  {g:8.1f}  {s:8.1f}")

n = len(gold)
mean_g = sum(gold) / n
mean_s = sum(silver) / n
print(f"\nMean gold   = {mean_g:.4f}")
print(f"Mean silver = {mean_s:.4f}")

# OLS slope and intercept: silver = slope * gold + intercept
num = sum((g - mean_g) * (s - mean_s) for g, s in zip(gold, silver))
den = sum((g - mean_g) ** 2 for g in gold)
slope = num / den
intercept = mean_s - slope * mean_g
print(f"\nSlope     = {slope:.8f}")
print(f"Intercept = {intercept:.8f}")

# Predicted silver
pred = [slope * g + intercept for g in gold]
print("\nYear  Gold    Silver  Predicted  Residual")
for y, g, s, p in zip(years, gold, silver, pred):
    print(f"{y}  {g:8.1f}  {s:8.1f}  {p:8.4f}  {s-p:8.4f}")

# R-squared
ss_res = sum((s - p) ** 2 for s, p in zip(silver, pred))
ss_tot = sum((s - mean_s) ** 2 for s in silver)
r_squared = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
print(f"\nSS_res = {ss_res:.6f}")
print(f"SS_tot = {ss_tot:.6f}")
print(f"R^2    = {r_squared:.10f}")
print(f"R^2 (rounded to 2dp) = {round(r_squared, 2)}")
PY
